confidence_notes: Restaurant and bar anchors rest on 2025 crowd-sourced Expatistan figures for Cusco with small samples, plus national Peru comparisons. I found no 2026 Cusco price data. Beer and cocktail are weakly sourced. The wine glass is estimated from a bottle price, and no per-glass price was found. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Cusco's tourist market, not checked against live listings or current rates. The FX value comes from search-result snippets that cite RBA exchange-rate pages; I did not open the RBA page directly, and the snippets showed inconsistent dates. The 0.6955 rate is the value the snippets give for 15 October 2026.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors are based on Cusco-specific Expatistan crowd-sourced averages (2025), cross-checked against Peru national restaurant comparisons from NationMaster and BearSavings. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, not sourced.
